description: This file defines a SwiftUI view for a login screen named 'LoginView'. It manages user input for email and password, submits login requests to a session manager, and displays appropriate UI feedback and error messages.

classes.name: LoginView
classes.description: A SwiftUI View that provides a user interface for user login, handles form submission, and displays validation and error messages.

methods.name: submit()
methods.description: Asynchronous method that attempts to log in the user using the session object and manages UI state based on success or failure.
